name: Fukigen na Itoko
source:
Main character goes to the relatives' house in the countryside for the summer vacations. Female cousin there is a cute and noisy girl. But she is so defenseless in her sleep. Why does not she wear a bra...?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
暑假，主角前往鄉下親戚家。那裡的表妹是個可愛又吵鬧的女孩，可她睡著時毫無防備。為什麼連胸罩都不戴……？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
